title: I love this app, but there are some things I would like to be fixed ♥️
body: The app is awesome and the pets are cute, but it makes me sad that I can’t sign in or save my progress. It would be a waste if I couldn’t keep my old records. The only available option for me is signing in with the phone number and it’s always showing “error” and I have tried more than 2 days. I suggest it would be convenient if there were other options like email or appleid. Thanks for the lovely app btw!
author: Swan983

title: Fun
body: This is a super fun way to keep you motivated on daily tasks even for adults
